decisive_spans.text: Global loss of expression of FH
pathogenic variant in the FH gene (FHc.999C > A p.Cys333Ter)

response.rationale: The presence of a pathogenic variant in the FH gene and global loss of FH expression are highly specific to Hereditary Leiomyomatosis and Renal Cell Cancer (HLRCC) syndrome. While bilateral breast nodules suggestive of fibroadenomas are a supportive finding, the genetic and immunohistochemical findings are decisive for D3 over D2.
